== Fair use rationale ==
* '''Description:''' head-and-shoulders portrait of Mark Schaffer.
* '''Purpose:''' identifies the subject of the article [[Mark Schaffer]] and his row on [[Anagrams]] (the card [[Harc Seff]]). No free photograph of him is known.
* '''Portion used:''' the whole image at the low resolution (200 × 200 px) LinkedIn publishes; no larger copy was taken.
* '''Replaceability:''' a Decipher-era or convention photograph would replace this one; none was found on his Decipher Squadrons profile page or his fan site gold41.mhost.com.
* '''Market effect:''' a small, non-commercial copy on a fan encyclopedia does not replace any commercial use of the photograph.
* '''Copyright:''' the photographer or Mark Schaffer. Used under fair use for identification only.
